answer: The meadow schedule is applied in grove and vault reveals each instalment. A payout is split so that 41% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An copycat thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4252 identities would post 2760 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
